# PINDÉ Window System Supply
> Aluminium and FRP window-system materials, machined components and glass-free CKD kits from Chongqing for local fabrication in Russian-speaking markets.

## Systems
- /en/systems: Aluminium & FRP window profile systems — overview and comparison
- /en/systems/aluminium: Thermally broken aluminium window-and-door systems — profiles, components, BOM, launch package. For buyers searching "aluminium window profile systems China", "thermally broken aluminium profiles"
- /en/systems/frp: FD90 and FDTL140 cold-climate full-FRP systems plus PD75 Ultra FRP Core — qualified strength, thermal and weather-performance programmes
- /en/systems/frp/fd90: FD90 90mm full-FRP cold-climate casement and tilt-turn window — Grade 10 catalogue thermal insulation, Uw references down to 0.85 W/(m²·K)
- /en/systems/frp/fdtl140: FDTL140 140mm full-FRP side-press sliding door — 200kg leaf capacity, Grade 10 catalogue thermal insulation, Uw reference 1.02 W/(m²·K)
- /en/systems/frp/xd75: PD75 75mm aluminium-composite system — aluminium shells, 45mm Ultra FRP Core, outward-opening and inward tilt-turn configurations (the established URL retains the xd75 slug)

## Product Catalog
- /en/systems/aluminium: 19 aluminium window & door products — casement, sliding, folding, push-out, swing doors, interior systems
- /en/systems/aluminium/a65-casement-window: A65 Casement Window — 65mm profile, PA66GF25 thermal break, EPDM seals
- /en/systems/aluminium/a110-casement-window: A110 Casement Window — 110.5mm profile, glazing up to 120mm
- /en/systems/aluminium/a120-casement-window: A120 Casement Window — flagship, 35.3mm thermal break, triple glazing up to 130mm

## Supply Formats
- /en/supply: P1 (Complete system kit), P2 (Cut-to-length & machined), P3 (Glass-free CKD kit) — comparison and responsibility matrix
- /en/supply#p3: CKD window kits — glass-free, machined profiles packed by opening, for buyers searching "CKD window kits", "glass-free window kits"

- Manufacturing: 100,000 m² integrated base, Chongqing, China
- Supply levels: P1 (system kit), P2 (machined), P3 (glass-free CKD)
- Markets: Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, CE, AS2047, NFRC, 60+ patents
- Target: B2B only — window manufacturers, fabricators, importers, project procurement (NOT retail)
